summary: ESLint v10 (2026-02-06) is the only supported major. v9 reached EOL on 2026-08-06, and v8 and below are EOL and flagged deprecated on npm. v10 removed eslintrc completely: .eslintrc.*, .eslintignore, ESLINT_USE_FLAT_CONFIG, --env and /* eslint-env */ no longer work. Use eslint.config.js (flat config).
